intro: The Broken Construct involves lending aid to Riaani Nightwind, who is shoulder-deep inside the innards of an inoperable machine. Sent as an assistant by Ayessa, travelers must listen to Riaani's plans to discover how they can help restore the device.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then.
Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't imagine why anyone would want to steal these components from this construct. Other than the gyrozephyr these components have almost no practical application. Even the gyro would be nigh-useless outside of its intended purpose.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for scavenging these materials. I imagine that some of this wasn't terribly easy to get.
With these parts I can get the construct up and running again. From there we can just hope that its memory is intact and it can tell us who took its components.
